---
title: "Privacy and Sharing"
description: "A final review before this portfolio is submitted or published."
---

Public publishing is optional. A local render, private repository, approved
classroom submission, or printed copy can demonstrate the same learning.

## Remove before sharing

- student numbers, private email addresses, schedules, classroom codes, and
  location details;
- passwords, tokens, private repository links, and network information;
- device serial numbers, school asset labels, and identifying labels in photos;
- names, faces, voices, or work belonging to other students without permission;
- copyrighted media that you are not permitted to republish.

## Keep when approved

- your own calculations, code, diagrams, measurements, and reflection;
- approved photographs that do not identify people or private information;
- short quotations, adaptations, and media with suitable citation and licence;
- honest descriptions of collaborators and your own contribution.

## Final privacy check

Search the complete source folder for your student number, school email,
passwords, tokens, and private URLs. Inspect every photograph at full size.
Render the site and check what a visitor can actually open before sharing it.
